The KoffyKraft Roast Manual

A walk through KoffyKraft Roast in the order real work happens, from the plot to the cup. It assumes nothing: one thing at a time, in plain words, with a picture of every screen and a link that opens the same place in the app.

Every button named here is checked against the app before these pages are made. Every picture is the real app, filled with a made-up estate.
